external_benchmark_reference.name: Fantasy Football Analytics - Which Site Has the Most Accurate Fantasy Football Projections?
external_benchmark_reference.key_result: Simple multi-source averaging was more robust than individual sources and slightly outperformed historical-accuracy weighting overall; retain equal weighting until FSFFL-specific held-out validation supports complexity.

historical_accuracy_evidence.interpretation: Absence from the benchmark is not evidence of poor accuracy; it means FSFFL should not claim comparable long-run validation yet.

razzball.notes: Existing FSFFL statistical projection source. Useful as an independent vote, but currently less externally validated than FFToday/FantasyPros/CBS in the identified 2014-2025 benchmark.

historical_accuracy_evidence.summary: Consistently competitive across positions; recent 3-season results were especially strong at WR and TE, with solid QB/RB performance.

fftoday.notes: Public season-long statistical projections. Raw passing/rushing/receiving stats are normalized and rescored under FSFFL rules; provider fantasy-point totals are not used.

fantasypros.overlap_policy: Do not count any explicitly included FantasyPros component expert/source as an additional independent vote unless source-level overlap has been demonstrated absent.

historical_accuracy_evidence.summary: Best or near-best long-run accuracy across QB/RB/WR/TE in the published comparison; aggregate nature requires overlap controls.

fantasypros.notes: Consensus/aggregate source. Underlying component projections must not also be counted as independent votes unless overlap is explicitly de-duplicated.

historical_accuracy_evidence.summary: Strong long-run results, including the best historical RB MAE in the published comparison.

cbs.activation_requirement: Enable only after a tested FSFFL adapter reliably maps and rescales current CBS statistical projections with acceptable coverage.
cbs.notes: High-priority third independent source candidate based on external historical accuracy and current public detailed projections.
